title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: memory citations show which memories shaped a response
summary: The notice, roadmap and Microsoft documentation support the rollout, default state and memory controls. Minor corrections should clarify that custom instructions are not discoverable in Purview, qualify the Graph administrator role for delegated access, and cite the user licensing reference.

claims.quote: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer.

claims.claim: The Personalization tab shows custom instructions that shaped the response.

claims.claim: No administrator-center UI path for Enhanced personalization is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Enhanced personalization memory admin center UI settings tenant turn off". Opened Learn memory management, enhanced-personalization overview, Graph update and configure-copilot-admin-center. No admin UI path for this control appeared.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization updates the Enhanced personalization setting.
claims.quote:
Update the properties of an enhancedPersonalizationSetting object.
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/settings/people/enhancedpersonalization

claims.claim: The request body sets the Boolean isEnabledInOrganization property.
claims.quote: isEnabledInOrganization | Boolean | If true, enables the enhanced personalization control and therefore related features as defined in control enhanced personalization privacy Required.

claims.claim: The optional disabledForGroup property takes a Microsoft Entra group ID and disables the control for its users.
claims.quote: disabledForGroup | String | The ID of a Microsoft Entra group to which the value is used to disable the control for populated users. Optional.

claims.claim: The Graph API is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Why it matters; Scope: Prerequisite
claims.claim: Copilot memory depends on the Enhanced personalization control.
claims.quote: In some cases, this renders a feature disabled for use, such as Copilot memory, which is dependent on this data processing scenario.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Admins can turn memory off for the tenant or specific users through a Microsoft Entra group.
claims.quote: Admins can manage memory through the Enhanced Personalization control. This control is on by default and can be turned off for the entire tenant or for specific users through a Microsoft Entra group.

claims.claim: Memories are stored in a hidden folder in the user's Exchange mailbox.
claims.quote: Memories, which include saved memories, details inferred from chat history and custom instructions, are stored in the user's Exchange mailbox in a hidden folder.

claims.claim: Memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data.
claims.quote: Thus, memories follow the same security and compliance policies as other mailbox data, such as Customer Lockbox and encryption at rest.

claims.claim: Admins can search users' memory through Microsoft Purview eDiscovery or Content Search.
claims.quote: Admins can search their users' memory in Microsoft Copilot via Microsoft Purview eDiscovery or Content Search. Custom instructions aren't yet discoverable in these solutions.
claims.fix: Append to the eDiscovery sentence: 'Custom instructions are not yet discoverable in these solutions.' The cited Learn page supports this qualification; retain the existing statement about searching memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Purview retention policies and labels do not apply to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: Retention policies and retention labels configured in Purview by organization admins don't apply to Copilot memory.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Memory and personalization actions do not generate Purview audit log entries.
claims.quote: Memory and personalization actions don't generate audit log entries in Purview.

claims.claim: Admins cannot restrict the type of information added to Copilot memory.
claims.quote: No, admins can't restrict what type of information is added to Copilot memory.

claims.claim: Turning Enhanced personalization off stops applying custom instructions without removing them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Custom instruction control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying custom instructions, but doesn't remove those custom instructions.

claims.claim: Turning Enhanced personalization off stops applying saved memories without removing them.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.claim: With Enhanced personalization off, all details from chat history are deleted after 30 days.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Chat history control is turned off at the end-user level, then all details from chat history are deleted after 30 days.

claims.claim: Users whose Enhanced personalization is off see Custom instructions, Saved memories and Chat history off in Settings > Personalization.
claims.quote: End-users that have the Enhanced personalization control turned off see the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization as turned off.

claims.claim: Users cannot turn those settings on while Enhanced personalization is off.
claims.quote: They can't turn on these settings.

claims.claim: The Graph update reference names People Administrator as its least privileged role.
claims.quote: For delegated access using work or school accounts, the admin must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role. People Administrator is the least privileged role supported for this operation.
claims.fix: Replace the role clause with 'For delegated access using work or school accounts, the Graph update reference names People Administrator as the least privileged role.' Retain PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All and the beta qualification.

claims.claim: PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All is the permission for the update operation.
claims.quote:
Delegated (work or school account) | PeopleSettings.ReadWrite.All | Not available.

claims.claim: Settings > Personalization contains end-user controls.
claims.quote: the user-level controls for Custom instructions, Saved memories, and Chat history in Settings > Personalization
